about_the_game:
This game, although inspired by occurring modern events, does not aim to represent any real events, people, or countries, nor to sway the opinions of anyone buying and playing it.

VULTURE – The Droner is a hybrid psychological-action game blending puzzling 2D office strategy with open-world 3D drone combat in a hostile, "mordenesque" war-torn world.
The neutral country of Azmar is undergoing an invasion from the hostile barbarous Volden. The government has issued a national defense program which grants each registered citizen of Azmar hazard pay for each enemy soldier they are forced to kill.
(Although the money is very good, the program is under no circumstance an official encouragement from the government to actively attack soldiers; as morality implies, killing should only be done in self-defense!)

You are "The Vulture," an ex-Town Hall janitor who became aware of the program months before it was publicly announced. Seeing a golden opportunity, you sprang into action and figured out the best way to capitalize on the situation. With fiery disdain in your eyes, you set up a base in a key military strategic location; watching and waiting for your first paycheck to arrive.

THE GAMEPLAY
Split between two contrasting perspectives, VULTURE – The Droner challenges you to survive through both claustrophobic 2D office management and high-stakes 3D drone operations.
In the office, you’ll juggle money, upgrades, and radio transmissions while carefully plotting coordinates and waiting out each tense day.
In the skies, you’ll pilot your drone across an open battlefield — sneaking, bombing, collecting identification codes, and making sure enemies never trace you back to your base. Success requires patience, resourcefulness, and wit.

FEATURES

  • Experimental hybrid gameplay: 2D office management meets open-world 3D drone combat

  • Claustrophobic 2D office management focused on money, upgrades, and survival over 21 days in hostile territory

  • Plot coordinates, listen to radio chatter, and make witty choices to keep the program running

  • Open-world drone missions with bombing runs, stealth movement, and resource collection

  • Confuse enemies and avoid drawing attention to your hidden base

  • Collect enemy identification codes to prove kills and maximize hazard pay

  • Original soundtrack with atmospheric ambience and a dedicated in-game music channel

content_descriptors.notes: This game depicts fictional armed conflict between two nations. It contains realistic violence involving firearms, explosives, and drone strikes, including depictions of injury and death. Some scenes feature war-themed imagery such as destroyed environments, civilian distress, and military operations. While the setting draws inspiration from modern warfare, all characters, nations, and events are fictional. Player discretion is advised.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.14 or higher
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.5 GHz or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 5000 or equivalent with 1 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 or higher
  • Processor: Quad-core 3.0 GHz or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon Pro 555X / Apple M1 GPU or equivalent with 2 GB+ VRAM
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
